title: The Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1982-04-12
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 2448 Tagged. Transfer by Andrew F. 05/2011
source: AUD: 2x Nakamichi CM300's > Sony TC-D5M > TDK MA-90's. Set up behind the stage, recorded from the rear-facing P.A. system. Taped by Joe Morrone.

ai_review.summary: Sweet 16‑bit FLAC capture with a floating Jerry Garcia guitar on Peggy‑O.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as a clear, sweet 16‑bit FLAC source, though one listener wishes for a higher‑resolution (24‑bit) version. Musically the show shines especially on Peggy‑O, where Jerry’s guitar work is described as almost floating away, making it a favorite performance for fans.

ai_rating.rationale: One reviewer rates the show and recording highly (5 stars) while the other provides no star rating but notes only a desire for higher bit‑depth; overall the performance is strong and the audio quality good, leading to an estimated 4‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: 16‑bit FLAC files described as 'sweet' and clear; a reviewer requests a 24‑bit version, indicating the recording is solid but limited in resolution.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar on Peggy‑O is described as 'floating away' and a favorite moment.
